name: agent-skills
description: Reusable Cascade / Claude / Cursor / VS Code agent skills by M2Lab.io — eval-driven dev, debugging discipline, PR hygiene, spec-before-code, and more.

paragraphs: Reusable engineering methodologies, packaged as Agent Skills: debugging, pull-request hygiene, design specs, research reports, eval-driven development, skill authoring, and statistically sound skill evaluation. Each skill is a self-contained folder with a SKILL.md, plus the scripts, references and templates it needs. Nothing depends on another repository or on a particular tool.
Maintained by Michel Mesquita, PhD, CStat (Chartered Statistician, Royal Statistical Society), at M2Lab.io. Reviewed monthly.
features: You rewrote a skill description and its trigger rate went from 9/20 to 14/20. The 95% interval on that difference runs from −5 to +50 points: this sample can't tell the two versions apart.
Passing 3 of 3 runs is consistent with a true pass rate anywhere from 44% to 100%.
20 queries can never be worth more than 40 independent observations when runs of the same query are correlated (ICC 0.5), however many runs you add.
Pick the best of five equally good descriptions on 8 validation queries, and its expected score is 91% when each is really 75%.
It bundles a zero-dependency calculator (skillstats.py) whose interval maths is tested against published reference values.
